Name: Patrick Henry
Key_Traits: Visionary, fire-brand, anti-centralist, principled
Narrative_Hook: The revolution's loudest voice — and most suspicious of the government it's building. Events where ideological purity collides with pragmatic necessity.
Notes: Faction: Patriot. MilMods: Visionary(all) / Champion of Sun(L2+) / Healer(L3). Leads Sons of Liberty.

Name: Abigail Adams
Key_Traits: Intellectual, conscience, feminist, patient
Narrative_Hook: The voice that keeps the movement honest about who it's actually for. Events about inclusion, compromise, and what the revolution is willing to become.
Notes: Faction: Moderate. Leads Continental Congress.

Name: Thomas Paine
Key_Traits: Idealist, incendiary, stateless, visionary
Narrative_Hook: The man who lit the fire with a pamphlet. Events where principles collide with governance — he trusts the people absolutely and is sometimes wrong.
Notes: Faction: Radical. Leads Free Workers Union.

Name: Mercy Otis Warren
Key_Traits: Sharp, satirical, principled, overlooked
Narrative_Hook: The historian watching the revolution happen. Events where what's being recorded matters as much as what's being done. Abolitionist themes.
Notes: Faction: Patriot. Leads Abolitionist League.

Name: Daniel Shays
Key_Traits: Betrayed, resolute, working-class, stubborn
Narrative_Hook: The revolution that got left behind. Events about what the new government owes the people who fought for it. Tenant farmers / debt / land.
Notes: Faction: Populist. Leads Common Cause.

Name: Ualani Carlisle
Key_Traits: Bold, sardonic, restless, leads from front
Narrative_Hook: The player character. Events that put the presidency on the line — DC falls / morale collapses / impossible choices. 17 security detail objections unread.
Notes: Faction: Federal. Starts Tile 188 (DC). Level 3. Commands APF personally.

Name: Benjamin Tallmadge
Narrative_Hook: Methodical / loyal / paranoid / meticulous
Status: The Culper Ring is back. Events where intelligence is the weapon — double agents, intercepted dispatches, turning loyalists. Perfect anchor for Codebook spy system.
Notes: ADDED
column16: Faction: Patriot (Sons of Liberty affiliate). Historical: ran Washington's spy network 1778-1783. Pairs with Codebook CPF system.

Name: Phillis Wheatley
Narrative_Hook: Eloquent / principled / transcendent / overlooked
Status: Her poetry is reaching British-held territories and stoking rebellion from within. Events about cultural power as a weapon — words that outlast cannon fire.
Notes: ADDED
column16: Faction: Abolitionist League. Historical: first published African American poet (1773). Named representative for NP_04 cultural pool in story events.

Name: Francis Asbury
Narrative_Hook: Tireless / fire-and-brimstone / democratic / anti-slavery
Status: 300k miles of preaching in territory armies can't reach. Events about organizing the unorganized — frontier settlements / revival culture / faith as resistance.
Notes: ADDED
column16: Faction: Common Cause. Historical: 'Father of American Methodism.' Gives faith/harmony system a named face. Terrain: Woods/Foothills.

Name: Lord Cornwallis
Key_Traits: Aristocratic, dutiful, humiliated, competent
Narrative_Hook: The man who surrendered Yorktown and can't forget it. Events that make him reluctant to repeat that mistake — or force him into exactly that position again.
Notes: Leads Crown Loyalists. Level 2. Starts Tile 14. Needs full governor.gd entry if used in UK-side events.

Name: General Howe
Key_Traits: Cautious, political, frustrated, capable
Narrative_Hook: The general who hesitated at Brooklyn when he could have ended it. Events about military authority vs. political restraint — and what happens when hesitation has a cost.
Notes: Leads Tory Merchants + Military Command. Level 2. Starts Tile 14. Needs fleshing for events.

Name: Governor Carleton
Key_Traits: Pragmatic, caught between, loyalist by duty, sympathetic
Narrative_Hook: Canada's impossible position — colonial by law, revolutionary by proximity. Events about who Canada's loyalty actually belongs to.
Notes: Leads French Habitants + British Settlers + Indigenous Allies. Level 1. Starts Tile 201.

Name: Jessica Clear-Water
Key_Traits: Principled, direct, unbothered by protocol, always right about Britain
Narrative_Hook: Canada's de facto leader. Events about sovereignty, land rights, and what an alliance with the Continental Republic actually means for her people. The pivot character of the Canadian arc.
Notes: isLeader=true. Faction: Indigenous Allies. Level 3. Starts Tile 201 (Ottawa). CAN_CLEARWATER_01 arc. questComplete=true.

Name: Mark Penoit
Key_Traits: Pragmatic, military, stubborn, loyal on his own terms
Narrative_Hook: Jessica's counterweight — he thinks in fortifications where she thinks in futures. Events about the gap between alliance theory and battlefield reality. The man holding the eastern flank.
Notes: isVicePresident=true (double milMod as army commander). Faction: French Habitants. Level 2. Starts Tile 99 (Saint-Georges). CAN_PENOIT_01 arc.

Name: Calico Jack
Key_Traits: Theatrical, mercenary, pragmatic, effective
Narrative_Hook: The document in the dramatic coat. Events about the alliance of convenience — Nassau fights British for profit first patriotism second and the Republic should not forget this distinction.
Notes: Leads Nassau Pirates + Loyalist Refugees. Level 1. Alliance triggered by CL_182. Army: Nassau Raiders.

Name: Patricia Eubanks
Key_Traits: Exhausted / professional / wry / unflappable
Narrative_Hook: She has narrated this field twice. Events where institutional memory — someone who just keeps showing up — becomes the emotional anchor of a moment.
Notes: Featured in CL_006 / CX_005. 'Three days. Last time it was three days.'

Name: Joseph Brant (Thayendanegea)
Narrative_Hook: Strategic / proud / pragmatic / betrayed by everyone
Status: Allied with the British because American expansion is the greater threat. Can be shown a different way — but only if the Republic can prove it means something different. Variable alignment event tree.
Notes: PROPOSED
column16: Historical: Mohawk leader during Revolution. Starting ENEMY. Conversion arc possible via Abigail Adams or Phillis Wheatley events. Uses NP_07 names pool.

Name: Anne Bonny
Key_Traits: Fearless, charismatic, expensive, dangerous
Narrative_Hook: She has a letter of marque and a grudge against the Royal Navy. Will raid British supply lines for the right price — but she operates on her own terms and her terms change.
Notes: Historical pirate (game is already anachronistic). Nassau affiliate or independent. Naval combat events. Can be ally / mercenary / wild card.

Name: Mothman
Key_Traits: Urgent / sleepless / omniscient / misunderstood
Narrative_Hook: Has been trying to warn people for decades. Nobody listened until now. Events where intelligence comes from impossible sources — and what do you do when the warning is real.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_01_SUMMON. Content flag: kinky_lewd. Resource unlock: food (20-35). Dev req: 3.

Name: Jersey Devil
Key_Traits: Territorial / hostile / primordial / born wrong
Narrative_Hook: Born under controversial circumstances in the Pine Barrens. Does not negotiate territory. Does not discuss his mother. Events about belonging to a place so completely it becomes defense.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_02_SUMMON. Resource unlock: weapons (15-25). Dev req: 2.

Name: Bigfoot
Key_Traits: Enormous / quiet / principled / confirmed by footprint
Narrative_Hook: Communicates through action rather than statement. Events where solidarity shows up as presence — vast and undeniable and officially denied. Eleven counties of footprints.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_03_SUMMON. Resource unlock: wood (25-40). Dev req: 3.

Name: Thunderbird
Key_Traits: Ancient / immense / sovereign / reluctant
Narrative_Hook: Indigenous skies reclaiming themselves. Events where the revolution aligns with older grievances — the storm does not fight for the Republic so much as against the same enemy.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_04_SUMMON. Resource unlock: culture (20-35). Dev req: 3.

Name: Headless Horseman
Key_Traits: Headless / aggressive / terrifying / surprisingly loyal
Narrative_Hook: Cannot aim. Compensates with enthusiasm. Events where fear is the mission — Hudson Valley haunting runs / morale operations / British officers who decline to specify what they saw.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_05_SUMMON. Resource unlock: dollars (25-40). Dev req: 4.

Name: Chessie
Key_Traits: Ancient / vast / cooperative (with oysters) / diplomatic
Narrative_Hook: Stirring the bay and bringing forth bounty. Events about what belongs to the water and what the water will protect. Three Royal Navy frigates reporting unexplained weather damage.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_06_SUMMON. Resource unlock: food (30-50). Dev req: 2.

Name: The Bell Witch
Key_Traits: Independent / hostile / precise / terrifying in beds
Narrative_Hook: Operates on her own terms. Does not follow orders — only alignment of interests. Events where psychological pressure becomes military advantage. Andrew Jackson will not return to that farmhouse.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_07_SUMMON. Resource unlock: magic (10-20). Dev req: 3.

Name: Old Ironsides
Key_Traits: Unsinkable / refuses retirement / has eaten admirals / impossible
Narrative_Hook: The ship that cannot die. Events about legacy and refusal — things that are too important to let go even when the official order comes down. Three admirals tried.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_08_SUMMON. Fixed tile 63. Resource unlock: weapons (30-50). Dev req: 5.

Name: Valley Forge Guardian
Key_Traits: Frozen / vast / collective / the army that stayed
Narrative_Hook: Not Washington — the army itself. Events about what endurance means when there is nothing left but staying. The ground that remembers starving and still holds the line.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_09_SUMMON. Fixed tile 1. Resource unlock: manpower (50-80). Dev req: 4.

Name: Snallygaster
Key_Traits: Half-reptile / half-bird / aggressively territorial / German-immigrant folklore
Narrative_Hook: Bridges Old World fears and New World land. Events about settlers and what they carried with them — and what the mountains had here long before anyone carried anything.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_10_SUMMON. Resource unlock: metal (15-25). Dev req: 3.

Name: Paul Revere
Key_Traits: Agitated / fast / loud / one more time
Narrative_Hook: He has done this before and he will do it again with the same energy as the first time. Events about urgency — the moment when the warning has to reach everyone and there is exactly one ride to do it.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_11_SUMMON. Resource unlock: culture (20-35). Dev req: 3.

Name: Liberty Bell
Key_Traits: Cracked / resonant / permanent / no one takes responsibility for the crack
Narrative_Hook: The crack is a feature. Events about symbols and what they mean after they've broken — still ringing, still carrying, still the point.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_12_SUMMON. Fixed tile 2. Resource unlock: dollars (30-50). Dev req: 4.

Name: Green Mountain Ghost
Key_Traits: Invisible / productive / nocturnal / Vermont
Narrative_Hook: The Boys who never left. Events about place-loyalty — haunting as caretaking, presence as protection. Settlers working harder and not elaborating on why.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_13_SUMMON. Resource unlock: happiness (20-35). Dev req: 2.

Name: Mount Rushmore
Key_Traits: Granite / arguing / Washington tries to chair / Lincoln watching Ualani
Narrative_Hook: Four presidents in the situation room. Events where history and present collide — Roosevelt interrupting / Jefferson raising philosophical objections / Lincoln quietly approving of Carlisle.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_14_SUMMON. Content flag: kinky_lewd. Resource unlock: mandate (25-40). Dev req: 5.

Name: Skunk Ape
Key_Traits: Massive / fragrant / passionate about swamp sovereignty / Floridian
Narrative_Hook: He has been here longer than the settlers. Events about Florida — which has always operated by different rules — and what it means that even the swamp takes sides.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_15_SUMMON. Resource unlock: food (15-25). Dev req: 2.

Name: Eternal Minuteman
Key_Traits: Ready / always / 1775 to now / breeches situation unspecified
Narrative_Hook: He was ready then. He is ready now. Events about what 'ready' means when the cause is permanent — the first shot still echoing / the same green at Lexington / the question whose answer is already known.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_16_SUMMON. Fixed tile 61. Resource unlock: manpower (30-50). Dev req: 3.

Name: Lincoln's Ghost
Key_Traits: Spectral / useful / sits in the hard chairs / two in the morning wisdom
Narrative_Hook: Still in the White House. Has opinions about the East Bedroom. Events where the weight of freedom's unfinished business arrives at 2am with something useful to say. The arc bends. This is the bending part.
Notes: Summon event: PROT_17_SUMMON. Fixed tile 188. Resource unlock: mandate (20-35). Dev req: 3.

Name: Wetlands Fisher
Key_Traits: Resourceful / local / read the water / invisible in the marsh
Narrative_Hook: Guerrilla intel from the marshes. Events: local knowledge beats military strategy.
Notes: Army: Wetlands Rangers. Name pools: NP_01 (English) / NP_04 (African American).

Name: Appalachian Miner
Key_Traits: Gritty / practical / knows what's underground / doesn't trust suits
Narrative_Hook: The mountain knows what armies don't. Events: tunnel warfare / resource extraction under fire / Crown mining operations.
Notes: Army: Mountain Militia. Name pool: NP_03 (Southern Appalachian).

Name: Ivy League Dropout
Key_Traits: Brilliant / resentful / overqualified / finding purpose
Narrative_Hook: Left the academy for the cause. Events: intelligence work / propaganda / the tension between education and action.
Notes: Army: Volunteer Regiment. Pools: NP_01 / NP_09 (Irish) / NP_10 (Jewish).

Name: Seminole Fighter
Key_Traits: Fierce / sovereign / tactical / fighting their own war inside this one
Narrative_Hook: The revolution within the revolution. Events: Indigenous-colonial alliance tensions / Florida territory / the war this person has already been fighting.
Notes: Army: Forest Skirmishers. Pool: NP_07 (Indigenous).

Name: Green Mountain Farmer
Key_Traits: Self-reliant / stubborn / locally loyal / works while talking
Narrative_Hook: Vermont energy. Events: community defense / food security under occupation / the farmer who showed up with a musket and stayed.
Notes: Army: Green Mountain Boys. Pools: NP_01 / NP_06 (French/Acadian).

Name: Chesapeake Shipwright
Key_Traits: Skilled / sea-knowledge / proud / loyal to the bay
Narrative_Hook: Builds the boats that win naval engagements. Events: harbor defense / supply routes / what happens when the bay takes sides (see Chessie).
Notes: Army: Harbor Guard. Pools: NP_01 / NP_04.

Name: Loyalist Turncoat
Key_Traits: Conflicted / calculating / high risk / knows too much
Narrative_Hook: Someone who switched sides and carries the weight of what they did before. Events: double-agent dynamics / loyalty tests / the moment of choosing. Perfect Codebook commander.
Notes: Army: Irregular Rifles. Pools: NP_01 / NP_02 (German).

Name: Tobacco Belt Drifter
Key_Traits: Wandering / observant / knows every road / doesn't stay
Narrative_Hook: Intel from plantation country. Events: supply route sabotage / plantation economy / freedom-seeking enslaved persons they've encountered on the road.
Notes: Army: Frontier Militia. Pools: NP_03 / NP_04.

Name: War Widow
Key_Traits: Grieved / determined / refuses to stop / twice as capable
Narrative_Hook: Lost someone and turned it into fuel. Events: civilian resistance / community organizing / the cost of the revolution measured in who isn't here anymore.
Notes: Army: Liberty Brigade. Pools: NP_01 / NP_04 / NP_09.

Name: Indigenous Scout
Key_Traits: Expert / sovereign / watching both sides / their own agenda
Narrative_Hook: Navigates territory as a native — which means knowing things armies can't know. Events: indigenous alliance tensions / land promises / what the Republic will and won't guarantee.
Notes: Army: Ranger Company. Pool: NP_07.

Name: Boston Rabble-Rouser
Key_Traits: Loud / energetic / persuasive / occasionally right
Narrative_Hook: The voice that turns a crowd into a movement. Events: propaganda / faction loyalty swings / tea parties (metaphorical and otherwise).
Notes: Army: Sons of Liberty. Pools: NP_01 / NP_09.

Name: Continental Surgeon
Key_Traits: Pragmatic / exhausted / keeps going / occasionally miraculous
Narrative_Hook: Has seen everything. Events: field medicine under fire / the moral weight of triage / what surgeons know about war that generals don't.
Notes: Army: Continental Corps. Pools: NP_01 / NP_02.

Name: Nantucket Sailor
Key_Traits: Salt-hardened / independent / reads the ocean / Republic of the sea
Narrative_Hook: The water is their home. Events: naval engagements / whale-road intelligence / Old Ironsides crew candidates.
Notes: Army: Naval Infantry. Pool: NP_01.

Name: Frontier Preacher
Key_Traits: Traveling / fire / democratic / anti-slavery undertone
Narrative_Hook: The sermon that reaches places armies can't. Events: faith organizing / frontier settlement / the preacher who shows up during the occupation and keeps going.
Notes: Army: Righteous Rifles. Pool: NP_03. Pairs with Francis Asbury event arcs.

Name: DC Bureaucrat
Key_Traits: Process / paperwork / outlasts everything / unexpectedly essential
Narrative_Hook: Keeps the Republic running while everyone else is fighting. Events: mandate/corruption crises / the infrastructure of revolution / 'the paperwork has to be filed.'
Notes: Army: Federal Guard. Pools: NP_01 / NP_04.

Name: Rust Belt Steelworker
Key_Traits: Strong / union-minded / makes things / doesn't waste
Narrative_Hook: The worker who built the weapons. Events: production under occupation / sabotage from inside the factory / labor organization.
Notes: Army: Iron Brigade. Pools: NP_02 / NP_09.

Name: Plantation Deserter
Key_Traits: Free / resolute / no going back / earned everything
Narrative_Hook: Left. Won't return. Events: freedom-seeking narrative / what the revolution owes / the soldier who is fighting for something different than everyone else.
Notes: Army: Freedom Rifles. Pool: NP_04.

Name: Swamp Witch
Key_Traits: Uncanny / rooted / knows old things / not on your side but aligned
Narrative_Hook: Not a soldier. Something else. Events: folk magic / bayou knowledge / the supernatural undercurrent beneath colonial America. The Bell Witch's neighbor.
Notes: Army: Bayou Raiders. Pools: NP_04 / NP_05 (Spanish/Caribbean).

Name: Caribbean Privateer
Key_Traits: Mercenary / effective / sea-expert / complicated allegiances
Narrative_Hook: Fighting for profit that happens to align with the cause. Events: Nassau alliance support / privateering contracts / the difference between a pirate and a patriot.
Notes: Army: Privateer Corps. Pool: NP_05. Calico Jack / Anne Bonny story hooks.

Name: Hawaiian Refugee
Key_Traits: Displaced / perceptive / diplomatic / Ualani Carlisle's people
Narrative_Hook: Far from home in a war that's also theirs. Events: Pacific connection / diplomatic bridge / being the one person who understands both worlds.
Notes: Army: Pacific Guard. Pool: NP_08 (Hawaiian). Thematic pair with Ualani Carlisle.

Name: Border Mercenary
Key_Traits: Pragmatic / price-driven / effective / loyalty to the coin
Narrative_Hook: Fights for whoever pays. Has been paid by the Republic. Events: mercenary loyalty tests / the moment money isn't enough / defection risk.
Notes: Army: Border Company. Pools: NP_03 / NP_05.

Name: Acadian Forest Ranger
Key_Traits: Quiet / displaced / francophone / knows the North
Narrative_Hook: The Acadians were displaced twice. Events: borderland intelligence / Canada alliance complexities / French-speaking America.
Notes: Army: Forest Rangers. Pool: NP_06 (French/Acadian).

Name: Gettysburg Descendant
Key_Traits: Historically burdened / determined / this ground means something / twice
Narrative_Hook: Carries the weight of what happened here before. Events: Gettysburg significance / Patricia Eubanks crossover / the second time this field matters.
Notes: Army: Heritage Guard. Pools: NP_01 / NP_04.

Name: LGBTQ+ Organizer
Key_Traits: Community-builder / strategic / visible / the revolution's unfinished promise
Narrative_Hook: Organizing the revolution within the revolution. Events: mandate and harmony / community defense / what freedom means when it means everyone.
Notes: Army: Solidarity Regiment. Pools: NP_01 / NP_04 / NP_09.

Name: Carnival Barker
Key_Traits: Loud / theatrical / persuasive / questionable / occasionally correct
Narrative_Hook: The propagandist you didn't hire but got anyway. Events: information warfare / morale manipulation / the spectacular stunt that somehow works.
Notes: Army: Showmen's Rifles. Pools: NP_03 / NP_05.
